question: Whose autobiography is titled as 'Wings of Fire: An Autobiography’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**APJ Abdul Kalam**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **APJ Abdul Kalam** authored the autobiography titled "Wings of Fire: An Autobiography".
 
• APJ Abdul Kalam was an eminent Indian scientist and the 11th President of India, known for his work in the field of aerospace engineering and his contributions to India's missile development programs.
 
• "Wings of Fire"
